unitTitle: B1 · Connect reasons, results and points of contrast
title: Grammar: Choose connectors by the relationship between ideas
subtitle: B1 · Unit 6: B1 · Connect reasons, results and points of contrast

steps.title: Choose connectors by the relationship between ideas
steps.body: A connector should show the relationship you mean. Use parce que / car for a reason; donc / par conséquent for a result; afin de + infinitive when the subject stays the same; pour que + subjunctive when the subject changes; and alors que / toutefois for contrast or qualification. Avoid stacking connectors. When evidence is limited, use peut or pourrait rather than claiming a result is certain.

steps.title: Choose connectors by the relationship between ideas
rows: Le trajet est plus long parce que la ligne est détournée.
The trip is longer because the route is diverted.
Le centre ouvre tôt afin de recevoir le groupe.
The centre opens early in order to welcome the group.
Nous affichons l'avis pour que chacun connaisse le détour.
We post the notice so that everyone knows about the detour.

steps.prompt: The centre opens early so it can welcome the group. Choose the connector.
steps.explain: The subject remains the centre, so use afin de + infinitive.

steps.prompt: We post a notice so that residents know. Choose the right structure.
steps.explain: The subject changes, so use pour que + subjunctive.
Toutefois introduces a contrast or qualification.
